 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajiv Roy
 Oral Order
4 10-01-2025 Heard Mr. Sanjeev Kumar Mishra, learned Senior counsel and the State 2.

The petitioner no. 3 is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 2108 of 2022 for the offence under Sections 420, 406, 468, 467, 506 and 34 of the I.P.C. lodged on 23.11.2022 by the complainant, Usha Rai.

3. Earlier while granting relief to petitioner no. 1 and 2 on 10.07.2024 on the ground that they are lady and have Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.40834 of 2024(4) dt.10-01-2025 purchased the land bonafidely, notice was issued to the opposite party no. 2 and as per the cause list she is represented through Mr. Saghir Ahmad.
However, there is no appearance on call.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is the case of the learned Senior counsel that he actually has purchased the land in the name of the petitioner no. 1 and 2 namely, Seema Devi and Rekha Devi being the father- in-law.

The main allegation is against Vinod Kumar Rai, the brother of the complainant, Usha Rai, a blind person and taking benefit of that, allegation is that the brother executed the land which actually belongs to her.
5. Learned APP opposes the prayer submitting that he being the purchaser cannot be exonerated from the charges.

( Rajiv Roy, J) Adnan/-
